agreements_term_order.name: agreements_term_order
agreements_term_order.value: "agreements"."ends_on" IS NULL OR "agreements"."starts_on" IS NULL OR "agreements"."ends_on" >= "agreements"."starts_on"

agreements_document_pair.name: agreements_document_pair
agreements_document_pair.value: ("agreements"."document_path" IS NULL) = ("agreements"."document_sha256" IS NULL) AND ("agreements"."document_sha256" IS NULL OR "agreements"."document_sha256" ~ '^[0-9a-f]{64}$')

audiokit_jobs_submitted_complete.name: audiokit_jobs_submitted_complete
audiokit_jobs_submitted_complete.value: "audiokit_jobs"."status" IN ('queued', 'failed') OR ("audiokit_jobs"."provider_job_id" IS NOT NULL AND "audiokit_jobs"."submitted_at" IS NOT NULL)

audiokit_jobs_finished_complete.name: audiokit_jobs_finished_complete
audiokit_jobs_finished_complete.value: "audiokit_jobs"."status" NOT IN ('succeeded', 'failed', 'canceled') OR "audiokit_jobs"."finished_at" IS NOT NULL

masters_ready_complete.name: masters_ready_complete
masters_ready_complete.value: "masters"."status" <> 'ready' OR ("masters"."sha256" IS NOT NULL AND "masters"."completed_at" IS NOT NULL)

orgs_display_name_length.name: orgs_display_name_length
orgs_display_name_length.value: "orgs"."display_name" IS NULL OR length("orgs"."display_name") BETWEEN 1 AND 60

orgs_favicon_png_format.name: orgs_favicon_png_format
orgs_favicon_png_format.value: "orgs"."favicon_png" IS NULL OR ("orgs"."favicon_png" LIKE 'iVBORw0KGgo%' AND length("orgs"."favicon_png") <= 44000)

rights_shares_target_matches_right.name: rights_shares_target_matches_right
rights_shares_target_matches_right.value: ("rights_shares"."right" = 'master' AND "rights_shares"."recording_id" IS NOT NULL AND "rights_shares"."composition_id" IS NULL) OR ("rights_shares"."right" = 'publishing' AND "rights_shares"."composition_id" IS NOT NULL AND "rights_shares"."recording_id" IS NULL)
